name: Frontier Industry
description: Build a working frontier economy, unlock advanced industry, and establish a regional foothold.

actions.text: Advanced hull construction is now the priority.

objectives.title: Build a Hauler Wing
objectives.description: Operate three Haulers at the same time.

objectives.title: Optional: Field Laboratory
objectives.description: Operate at least one Laboratory station.

objectives.title: Secure the Frontier
objectives.description: Expand beyond the starting foothold and control at least two galaxy systems.

completionText: The frontier operation is self-sustaining and ready for expansion.
failureText: The frontier operation collapsed before it became self-sustaining.
